email_body:
Hello,

This pack is prepared for the Georgiou Undergraduate and Graduate Positions expression of interest (ViewJobs listing and Georgiou Cadet and Graduate Development Program page). Please lodge it through the Georgiou careers portal rather than this email.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation for the right project.

Your EOI asks for tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering or related disciplines and a willingness to learn on live civil construction projects. That is the path I am seeking.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am lodging an expression of interest for Georgiou undergraduate and graduate roles, as listed on ViewJobs and described on your Cadet and Graduate Development Program page. I will submit through the Georgiou careers portal with this letter and resume.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian civil contractor employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation.
Your program's focus on real project experience, mentoring and competency progression is what I am looking for. My resume is attached and drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
